2.211.3
MapColorScale.ColorBarBorderColor
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapColorScale.ColorBarBorderColor element specifies the border color of the color bar for a
MapColorScale. The MapColorScale.ColorBarBorderColor element is optional. If this element is
present, its value MUST be an RdlColor or an expression that evaluates to an RdlColor. If this
element is not present, its value is interpreted as Black.
The following is the parent element of the MapColorScale.ColorBarBorderColor element.
Parent elements
MapColorScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapColorScale.ColorBarBorderColor element.
 <xsd:element name="ColorBarBorderColor" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
